Around [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Jace Forno]] attempted to steal precious [[B'rknaa]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Indobok]]. Her plan was foiled by the natives, with the help of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pitareeze family]] and their [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
